correspondence.coordinateConvention: Pixel centers. Native u=x-140, v=y-66; target qx=reference x-430, qy=reference y. Raw fit x=sx*u+tx, y=sy*v+ty. CRT affine qx=sx*u+skx*v+tx, qy=sky*u+sy*v+ty.
